reproduction_before_fix.scope: Initial six synthetic DOM/Auth boundary cases running the unmodified frontend

checks.name: existing strength motor generates six distinct exercises
compact onboarding generates and persists the selected week
compact onboarding labels the final action as review
sessions retain three recorded sets, feedback and history after reload
heavy session does not advise increasing the load
progression compares the same exercise with its previous performance
reported discomfort takes priority over progression
exercise replacement preserves group and avoids duplicates
corrupt legacy history has a readable empty fallback
a reload restores the existing profile, plan and daily home
account change replaces the loaded identity and never shows the preceding account
same-account sign-in event preserves an unsaved profile
expired session clears the private screen and preserves the owner-scoped retry queue
failed sign-out never reports successful logout while Auth retains the session
late response from A cannot replace B after an account change during a request
server rejection of an ended session returns to login without deleting local drafts
sign-out error is reported even when the SDK has already removed the local session
late network rejection from A cannot report an error in B
a pending sign-in notification cannot resurrect an account after sign-out
a changed Auth identity without its notification cannot authorize A operations with B credentials
Auth rejection preserves sets, completion feedback and write identity for the same account to retry
in-flight A write cannot remove the retry queues or display private data after B signs in
successful logout clears the private screen and retains only the owner-scoped retry data
password recovery displays its own screen with previous private data cleared
sign-out cancels a pending password-recovery screen
an incomplete profile opens onboarding and missing consent cannot submit training data
bodyweight-only fixture excludes cable, machine, barbell, dumbbell and bench requirements
single leg press does not unlock other machines or Smith
bench and dumbbells both required for dumbbell bench press
shared strength motor retains baseline output with complete equipment
shared progression prioritizes discomfort and heavy feedback
swaps also enforce equipment eligibility and no duplicates
offline outbox is isolated by user and preserves idempotent write ids

limits: Synthetic DOM/Auth/HTTP test doubles are not real-browser E2E or Supabase RLS proof.
No live account credential or personal training data used.
No staging deployment or public release performed.
Mobile device usability, full published journey and browser account isolation remain pending.

intermediate_verification.cause: New logout test asserted status at the intermediate SIGNED_OUT event; wait updated to observe the completed logout operation. No product-code change for this test timing issue.

pinned_sdk_note: Installed auth-js removes the local session in several signOut error paths; tests cover error returns both with and without SIGNED_OUT. No claim of a live retained token or database leak is made.
